narrative.weekly_mirror: At East Coast Park, Xiao Yu spent an hour collecting shells and bits of plastic, and you stayed with that moment as she discovered what was around her. Later, at the worker centre, you helped two new men file their claims and sat outside with the murukku, "feeling grateful for this strange second life".
narrative.tension_explanation: The recent entries hold ordinary care alongside a widening concern for other people and shared places. Taking Xiao Yu to the beach and helping the two men at the worker centre both gave that concern a concrete shape, while the earlier tiredness, silence, and discarded container remain part of the fuller picture rather than something to explain away.
